title: feat: group an agent call's generations
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
An agent call fans out into model steps and tool calls under a derived `ag_` token. Previously those child requests could not be attributed to the outer call, so the agent appeared free.

- Signs the outer `parentRequestId` into each run token as a verified claim (#12889)
- Records it as `parent_request_id` on every generation paid through that token
- Derives the rolling 7-day median agent cost by summing successful child prices onto the outer agent row
- Uses measured cost in balance preflight, price sorting, and requests-per-Pollen estimates even though the agent wrapper itself is free
- Keeps ordinary model calls unchanged and preserves a unique JWT `jti` per delegated token

Rollout:

1. Validate and deploy the Tinybird datasource/pipe to staging, then production.
2. Deploy Gen and Enter through the normal production workflow.

Existing events default to an empty parent ID, so grouping starts after deployment. The datasource column was validated in staging as a metadata-only ALTER with no row copy. The query remains runtime-only; a 14-day production probe scanned 15.3M rows in 0.36s.

Addresses #12889

gist.headline: Agent runs found their receipts
gist.blurb: Agent calls now gather their model steps and tool calls beneath one little `ag_` umbrella. The wrapper may be free, but Polli can finally see the whole picnic basket.
gist.summary: Agent-run tokens now carry a verified parent request ID, letting successful child generations be grouped onto their outer agent call and supplying a rolling 7-day median measured cost for balance preflight, model sorting, and requests-per-Pollen estimates.
gist.impact: Users can now see agent calls represented with realistic measured costs and more useful affordability and request estimates, while ordinary model calls keep their existing behavior.
gist.visual_concept: Depict an outer agent call as a cozy lime-green garden umbrella sheltering several small model and tool-call sprouts, with glowing price-tag pollen gathering back into one parent ledger. Polli, wearing a tiny accountant visor, gently connects each sprout to the umbrella with golden thread while the eager CRT Monitor Robot totals the grouped receipts; this represents verified parent IDs and measured aggregate agent costs.
